$comment: AI Credit rates per model, used to turn token counts into cost.
GitHub Copilot moved from premium requests to usage-based billing on 2026-06-01.
1 AI Credit = 0.01 USD. Consumption is computed from input, output and cached tokens,
at a rate that depends on the model.
This file is VERSIONED ON PURPOSE. Rates change; historical cost must never be
recomputed with current prices. Add a new entry to `history` when a rate changes,
and leave the previous one in place with its `until` date. The collector picks the
entry whose date range contains the run's timestamp.
WARNING: the numbers below are PLACEHOLDERS. They must be replaced with the real
published rates before the dashboard reports any cost figure. Until then the
collector leaves `credits` and `cost` unset and the UI renders them as an em dash,
which is honest. A wrong rate silently produces a wrong budget, which is worse

history.note: PLACEHOLDER - not verified against published rates. Do not report cost until `verified` is true.

plan-allowance.$comment: Included AI Credits per user per month, used to draw the budget line in the dashboard.
